docsPaths.when: user-visible behaviour changes — a flow, a screen, copy someone reads
a service boundary, the data model, or a contract between packages changes

sharedResources.resource: the Postgres database the test suite migrates and truncates
sharedResources.isolatedBy: tests/bootstrap takes the worktree path from `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --show-toplevel` (never $PWD, which spells a symlinked entry differently and hashes one worktree into two databases), hashes it into a database name, creates that database if absent, marks it with a COMMENT ON DATABASE carrying the same path — re-asserted on every boot, since a crash between create and comment would otherwise leave it unmarked — and exports the name before the framework boots; at the bootstrap, so a directly-run test file is isolated too, not only a run launched through gate. That comment is what reclaim reads, and an unmarked database is out of scope for the sweep forever

sharedResources.resource: the fixed port the e2e run binds
the content-addressed build cache every package script reaches through the task runner
sharedResources.isolatedBy: nothing isolates it and nothing needs to — entries are keyed by content, concurrent access is the task runner's designed mode, and a second writer of the same key writes the same bytes. This is NOT the null case: null says shared and CONTENDING, which narrows the wave; this says shared and safe by construction, which does not

frameworkSkills.when: Effect-TS services, layers, HTTP routes, typed errors

briefConventions: Match surrounding style. Pre-launch, forward-only — no backwards-compat shims. Comments explain the mechanism, not the history. Run /simplify over the full diff before committing when the slice is substantial. Never rebase, never self-merge.
